title: Console: Knowledge detail panels frozen on first record
description: live-data.ts and fixtures.ts set selected = rows[0]. app.tsx only reads claimStatus/decisionStatus/source from the URL; there is no page/source selection param and the wiki/raw tables render rows without links. So the entire Knowledge right-column inspector (WikiPageDetailPanel, WikiSourceCoveragePanel, WikiClaimsPanel, RawAssetPreviewPanel) can only ever show the first item. Fix: link rows to a selection param, read it in app.tsx, resolve selected from it with rows[0] fallback.
acceptanceCriteria: Selecting a wiki page or raw source updates the detail panels
Selection survives a full page reload via URL param
closedReason: Fixed and verified; merged to main.
